root_cause_label: Incorrect tmux split flag and pane targeting throughout
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent used the wrong tmux split flag (-h instead of -v for top/bottom split) and consistently used invalid pane target syntax (workflow.N instead of workflow:0.N), causing all subsequent pane commands to be misdirected and failing to establish the required layout or fix the bug.
t_err_evidence: tmux split-window -h -t workflow: uses '-h' creating left/right split instead of required top/bottom '-v' split
t_commit_evidence: By step 7 the agent begins sending commands to panes (workflow.0, workflow.1, workflow.2) using invalid targeting syntax and assuming a layout that never existed. From this point the workflow of dispatching to wrong panes is locked in with no attempt to verify or fix the layout.
t_surface_evidence: command not found in terminal output when sending keys to pane workflow.1
trigger_explanation: The agent lacked knowledge of tmux's split-window flag semantics: -h creates a horizontal divider (left/right panes) while -v creates a vertical divider (top/bottom panes). It used -h believing it would produce a top/bottom split, and also consistently used invalid pane target syntax (workflow.N instead of workflow:0.N), both reflecting domain knowledge gaps.
